title: Money, Interdependencies and the Ecosystem: Hybrid Stock-Flow Consistent Models in R
description: Lecture material (README and R code) for the course given at the Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE), Beijing, December 2026. The lectures cover aggregate stock-flow consistent (SFC) models, input-output SFC models with fixed and Sraffa-like prices, ecological IO-SFC models, agent-based SFC models, and their calibration and estimation. Interactive browser versions of the main models are included.
